facts = {

}
# frog_primary is False (yellow), frog_young unknown, so neither is in facts.

def neg(x):

rules = {
 "R1": (["swan_shouts_beaver"], "swan_unites_ostrich"),
 "R2": (["some_tears_dove"], "woodpecker_takes_monkey"),

 "R17": (["not bee_refuses_dinosaur"], "bee_reveals_zebra"),
 "R18": (["not bee_shouts_beetle", "bee_reveals_zebra"], "not bee_trades_stork"),
 "R19": (["bee_refuses_badger"], "bee_shouts_dragonfly"),
 "R20": (["bee_shouts_dragonfly"], "bee_wants_fangtooth"),
 "R21": (["frog_leafy"], "frog_destroys_wall"),
 "R22": (["swan_shouts_peafowl"], "swan_shouts_beaver"),
 "R23": (["snake_reduced_hours"], "snake_tears_dove"),
 "R24": (["frog_destroys_wall"], "swan_shouts_peafowl"),
}
# helper bridging rules (existential -> specific animal)
rules["H1"] = (["snake_tears_dove"], "some_tears_dove")

prefs = [("R11","R21"),("R15","R1"),("R16","R21"),("R24","R6"),

preferred_over = {}
for a, b in prefs:

changed = True

        # blocked if a preferred rule with satisfied antecedents derives the opposite
        blocked = False

                blocked = True
        if blocked or neg(concl) in facts:
            continue
        facts.add(concl)
        changed = True

for f in sorted(facts):

    res = "disproved"
